```{ojs}
//| echo: false
math = require("mathjs@12")

motor = ({
  // --- Números reales seguros -------------------------------------------
  real(v) { return (typeof v === "number" && Number.isFinite(v)) ? v : NaN; },

  // --- Parser de expresiones escritas por el alumnado --------------------
  compilar(txt) {
    try {
      const c = math.compile(txt);
      c.evaluate({x: 1, y: 1, t: 1, a: 1, b: 1, c: 1, k: 1, m: 1, n: 1, p: 1, r: 1, A: 1, w: 1, f: 1});
      return c;
    } catch (e) { return null; }
  },
  ev(comp, vars) {
    if (!comp) return NaN;
    try { return this.real(comp.evaluate(vars)); } catch (e) { return NaN; }
  },
  // Devuelve una función x -> y a partir de texto + parámetros
  fun(txt, pars = {}) {
    const c = this.compilar(txt);
    return c ? (x => this.ev(c, {...pars, x})) : (() => NaN);
  },

  // --- Muestreo ---------------------------------------------------------
  malla(f, a, b, n = 700) {
    const out = [];
    for (let i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
      const x = a + (b - a) * i / n;
      const y = f(x);
      out.push({x, y: Number.isFinite(y) ? y : null});
    }
    return out;
  },
  mallaParam(g, a, b, n = 700) {
    const out = [];
    for (let i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
      const t = a + (b - a) * i / n;
      out.push(g(t));
    }
    return out;
  },
  // Trocea el muestreo en tramos continuos (corta en huecos y saltos grandes)
  tramos(f, a, b, n = 900, salto = 25) {
    const pts = this.malla(f, a, b, n), out = [];
    let acc = [];
    for (const p of pts) {
      if (p.y === null || (acc.length && Math.abs(p.y - acc[acc.length - 1].y) > salto)) {
        if (acc.length > 1) out.push(acc);
        acc = p.y === null ? [] : [p];
      } else acc.push(p);
    }
    if (acc.length > 1) out.push(acc);
    return out;
  },

  // --- Cortes con rectas ------------------------------------------------
  cortesVert(pts, x0) {
    const r = [];
    for (let i = 1; i < pts.length; i++) {
      const p = pts[i - 1], q = pts[i];
      if (![p.x, p.y, q.x, q.y].every(Number.isFinite)) continue;
      const d1 = p.x - x0, d2 = q.x - x0;
      if (d1 === 0) r.push(p.y);
      else if (d1 * d2 < 0) r.push(p.y + (q.y - p.y) * d1 / (d1 - d2));
    }
    return r.sort((u, v) => u - v).filter((v, i, ar) => i === 0 || Math.abs(v - ar[i - 1]) > 1e-6);
  },
  cortesHoriz(f, y0, a, b, n = 1600) {
    return this.ceros(x => f(x) - y0, a, b, n);
  },

  // --- Ceros por bisección ---------------------------------------------
  ceros(f, a, b, n = 1600) {
    const r = [];
    let x0 = a, y0 = f(a);
    for (let i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
      const x1 = a + (b - a) * i / n, y1 = f(x1);
      if (Number.isFinite(y0) && Number.isFinite(y1)) {
        if (y0 === 0) r.push(x0);
        else if (y0 * y1 < 0) {
          let lo = x0, hi = x1;
          for (let k = 0; k < 60; k++) {
            const md = (lo + hi) / 2;
            if (f(lo) * f(md) <= 0) hi = md; else lo = md;
          }
          const z = (lo + hi) / 2;
          if (Math.abs(f(z)) < 1e-3) r.push(z);   // descarta asíntotas
        }
      }
      x0 = x1; y0 = y1;
    }
    return r.filter((v, i, ar) => i === 0 || Math.abs(v - ar[i - 1]) > 1e-5);
  },

  // --- Dominio numérico -------------------------------------------------
  dominio(f, a = -12, b = 12, n = 4800) {
    const iv = [], h = (b - a) / n;
    let ini = null;
    for (let i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
      const x = a + i * h, y = f(x);
      const ok = Number.isFinite(y) && Math.abs(y) < 1e9;
      if (ok && ini === null) ini = x;
      if (!ok && ini !== null) { iv.push([ini, x - h]); ini = null; }
    }
    if (ini !== null) iv.push([ini, b]);
    return iv.filter(([p, q]) => q - p > 2 * h);
  },
  // Recorrido numérico (tramos de valores alcanzados)
  recorrido(f, a = -12, b = 12, n = 6000) {
    const ys = [];
    for (let i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
      const y = f(a + (b - a) * i / n);
      if (Number.isFinite(y) && Math.abs(y) < 1e9) ys.push(y);
    }
    if (!ys.length) return [];
    ys.sort((u, v) => u - v);
    const iv = []; let ini = ys[0], ant = ys[0];
    const tol = (ys[ys.length - 1] - ys[0]) / 120 + 1e-9;
    for (const y of ys) {
      if (y - ant > tol) { iv.push([ini, ant]); ini = y; }
      ant = y;
    }
    iv.push([ini, ant]);
    return iv;
  },

  // --- Derivadas numéricas ---------------------------------------------
  d1(f, h = 1e-4) { return x => (f(x + h) - f(x - h)) / (2 * h); },
  d2(f, h = 1e-3) { return x => (f(x + h) - 2 * f(x) + f(x - h)) / (h * h); },

  // --- Intervalos de signo de una función g (sirve para f, f' y f'') ----
  signoIntervalos(g, a, b, n = 900) {
    const out = []; let ini = a, sg = Math.sign(g(a));
    for (let i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
      const x = a + (b - a) * i / n, s = Math.sign(g(x));
      if (!Number.isFinite(g(x))) { if (sg !== 0) out.push([ini, x, sg]); ini = x; sg = 0; continue; }
      if (s !== sg && s !== 0) {
        if (sg !== 0) out.push([ini, x, sg]);
        ini = x; sg = s;
      }
    }
    out.push([ini, b, sg]);
    return out.filter(([p, q]) => q - p > (b - a) / 200);
  },

  // --- Extremos relativos (por comparación local) ----------------------
  extremos(f, a, b, n = 900) {
    const res = [], h = (b - a) / n;
    for (let i = 2; i < n - 1; i++) {
      const x = a + i * h;
      const y0 = f(x - h), y1 = f(x), y2 = f(x + h);
      if (![y0, y1, y2].every(Number.isFinite)) continue;
      if (y1 > y0 && y1 > y2) res.push({x, y: y1, tipo: "máximo"});
      if (y1 < y0 && y1 < y2) res.push({x, y: y1, tipo: "mínimo"});
    }
    return res.filter((v, i, ar) => i === 0 || Math.abs(v.x - ar[i - 1].x) > 5 * h);
  },

  // --- Cotas en un intervalo -------------------------------------------
  cotas(f, a, b, n = 2000) {
    let mn = Infinity, mx = -Infinity, xmn = null, xmx = null;
    for (let i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
      const x = a + (b - a) * i / n, y = f(x);
      if (!Number.isFinite(y)) continue;
      if (y < mn) { mn = y; xmn = x; }
      if (y > mx) { mx = y; xmx = x; }
    }
    return {mn, mx, xmn, xmx};
  }
})

// ---------------------- Utilidades de formato y dibujo -----------------
fm = v => Number.isFinite(v) ? (Math.round(v * 1000) / 1000).toString().replace(".", ",") : "—"

fmIv = iv => iv.length === 0 ? "∅"
  : iv.map(([p, q]) => `${p <= -11.97 ? "(−∞" : "[" + fm(p)}, ${q >= 11.97 ? "+∞)" : fm(q) + "]"}`).join(" ∪ ")

trazo = (pts, color = "#2563eb", ancho = 2.6, guion = null) =>
  Plot.line(pts, {x: "x", y: "y", stroke: color, strokeWidth: ancho, strokeDasharray: guion})

trazos = (lista, color = "#2563eb", ancho = 2.6) =>
  lista.map(t => Plot.line(t, {x: "x", y: "y", stroke: color, strokeWidth: ancho}))

lienzo = (marcas, xd = [-8, 8], yd = [-8, 8], ex = "x →", ey = "↑ y", alto = 420) =>
  Plot.plot({width: 680, height: alto, grid: true, marginLeft: 50, marginBottom: 42,
    x: {domain: xd, label: ex}, y: {domain: yd, label: ey},
    marks: [Plot.ruleY([0], {stroke: "#111"}), Plot.ruleX([0], {stroke: "#111"}), ...marcas]})

etiqueta = (x, y, texto, color = "#dc2626", dy = -13) =>
  Plot.text([{x, y, t: texto}], {x: "x", y: "y", text: "t", dy, fill: color, fontWeight: "bold"})
```

::: {.callout-important collapse="false"}
## 📝 Cómo escribir funciones en los applets (guía de sintaxis)

Todos los applets con casilla de texto usan el mismo intérprete, así que **esta guía sirve para todos**. Escribe la expresión sin el `y =` ni el `f(x) =`.

| Quieres escribir | Se teclea | Ejemplo válido |
|---|---|---|
| $x^{2}$, $x^{5}$ | `x^2`, `x^5` | `x^3 - 3x` |
| $3x$ (producto) | `3x` o `3*x` | `2x^2 + 5x - 3` |
| fracción | `/` con paréntesis | `(2x + 3)/(x - 1)` |
| $\sqrt{x}$ | `sqrt(x)` | `sqrt(9 - x^2)` |
| $\sqrt[3]{x}$ | `cbrt(x)` o `nthRoot(x, 3)` | `cbrt(x - 1)` |
| $\lvert x\rvert$ | `abs(x)` | `abs(x^2 - 4)` |
| $\ln x$ (neperiano) | `log(x)` | `log(x + 2)` |
| $\log_{10} x$ | `log10(x)` | `log10(x)` |
| $\log_{2} x$ | `log(x, 2)` | `log(x + 1, 2)` |
| $e^{x}$ | `exp(x)` o `e^x` | `exp(-x^2)` |
| $2^{x}$ | `2^x` | `1000 · 1.03^x` → `1000*1.03^x` |
| $\operatorname{sen} x$, $\cos x$, $\tan x$ | `sin(x)`, `cos(x)`, `tan(x)` | `2sin(x) + 1` |
| parte entera | `floor(x)` | `5*floor(x/40)` |
| número $\pi$ | `pi` | `sin(pi*x)` |

**Reglas de oro**

1. El **decimal se escribe con punto**: `1.03`, no `1,03`.
2. Los paréntesis nunca sobran: `1/(x+1)` es distinto de `1/x+1`.
3. `log(x)` es el logaritmo **neperiano**. Si quieres el decimal, `log10(x)`.
4. Puedes usar los **parámetros de los deslizadores** dentro de tu expresión: si el applet tiene barras `a`, `b`, `c`, escribe `a*x^2 + b*x + c` y muévelas.
5. Si el borde de la casilla se pone rojo o la gráfica desaparece, hay un error de sintaxis: revisa paréntesis y `*`.

**Cinco expresiones para copiar y probar**

`x^2 - 4x + 3` · `(x^2 - 1)/(x - 2)` · `sqrt(x + 3)` · `log(x - 1)` · `abs(x^2 - 9)`
:::

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------
// tex2uni: convierte LaTeX sencillo en Unicode, para que las formulas
// generadas por los applets se vean sin depender de MathJax.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------
tex2uni = (entrada) => {
  const SUP = {"0":"\u2070","1":"\u00b9","2":"\u00b2","3":"\u00b3","4":"\u2074","5":"\u2075",
               "6":"\u2076","7":"\u2077","8":"\u2078","9":"\u2079","+":"\u207a","-":"\u207b",
               "(":"\u207d",")":"\u207e","n":"\u207f","i":"\u2071","m":"\u1d50","x":"\u02e3",
               "p":"\u1d56","q":"\u1d57","a":"\u1d43","b":"\u1d47","c":"\u1d9c",".":"\u00b7",",":"\u00b7"};
  const SUB = {"0":"\u2080","1":"\u2081","2":"\u2082","3":"\u2083","4":"\u2084","5":"\u2085",
               "6":"\u2086","7":"\u2087","8":"\u2088","9":"\u2089","+":"\u208a","-":"\u208b",
               "(":"\u208d",")":"\u208e","a":"\u2090","e":"\u2091","n":"\u2099","x":"\u2093",
               "o":"\u2092","i":"\u1d62","r":"\u1d63","v":"\u1d65"};
  const aSup = t => [...t].every(c => c in SUP) ? [...t].map(c => SUP[c]).join("") : "^(" + t + ")";
  const aSub = t => [...t].every(c => c in SUB) ? [...t].map(c => SUB[c]).join("") : "_" + t;
  const envolver = t => (t.length > 1 && !/^[\w.,]+$/.test(t)) ? "(" + t + ")" : t;

  let x = entrada;

  // --- simbolos (el \\ inicial es opcional por si se perdio al interpolar)
  const SIMBOLOS = [
    [/\\?operatorname\s*/g, ""], [/\\?mathrm\s*/g, ""], [/\\?displaystyle\s*/g, ""],
    [/\\?mathbb\{R\}/g, "\u211d"], [/\\?mathbb\{N\}/g, "\u2115"],
    [/\\?mathbb\{Z\}/g, "\u2124"], [/\\?mathbb\{Q\}/g, "\u211a"],
    [/\\?infty/g, "\u221e"], [/\\?cdot/g, "\u00b7"], [/\\?times/g, "\u00d7"],
    [/\\?div\b/g, "\u00f7"], [/\\?pm\b/g, "\u00b1"],
    [/\\?leq\b|\\?le\b/g, "\u2264"], [/\\?geq\b|\\?ge\b/g, "\u2265"],
    [/\\?neq\b|\\?ne\b/g, "\u2260"], [/\\?approx/g, "\u2248"], [/\\?equiv/g, "\u2261"],
    [/\\?varnothing|\\?emptyset/g, "\u2205"], [/\\?cup/g, "\u222a"], [/\\?cap/g, "\u2229"],
    [/\\?subset/g, "\u2282"], [/\\?notin/g, "\u2209"], [/\\?in\b/g, "\u2208"],
    [/\\?Rightarrow/g, "\u21d2"], [/\\?rightarrow|\\?to\b/g, "\u2192"],
    [/\\?longmapsto|\\?mapsto/g, "\u27fc"], [/\\?iff/g, "\u27fa"],
    [/\\?varphi/g, "\u03c6"], [/\\?alpha/g, "\u03b1"], [/\\?beta/g, "\u03b2"],
    [/\\?Delta/g, "\u0394"], [/\\?delta/g, "\u03b4"], [/\\?pi\b/g, "\u03c0"],
    [/\\?ldots|\\?dots|\\?cdots/g, "\u2026"],
    [/\\?left\s*/g, ""], [/\\?right\s*/g, ""], [/\\?quad|\\?qquad/g, "   "],
    [/\\?text\{([^{}]*)\}/g, "$1"], [/\\?,/g, " "], [/\\?;/g, " "], [/\\?!/g, ""]
  ];
  for (const [re_, a] of SIMBOLOS) x = x.replace(re_, a);

  // --- estructuras: se repite para resolver anidamientos de dentro afuera
  for (let k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
    x = x.replace(/\\?sqrt\[([^\[\]]*)\]\{([^{}]*)\}/g, (m, i, r) => aSup(i.trim()) + "\u221a" + envolver(r.trim()));
    x = x.replace(/\\?sqrt\{([^{}]*)\}/g, (m, r) => "\u221a" + envolver(r.trim()));
    x = x.replace(/\\?d?frac\{([^{}]*)\}\{([^{}]*)\}/g, (m, a, b) => envolver(a.trim()) + "/" + envolver(b.trim()));
    x = x.replace(/\^\{([^{}]*)\}/g, (m, t) => aSup(t.trim()));
    x = x.replace(/_\{([^{}]*)\}/g, (m, t) => aSub(t.trim()));
    x = x.replace(/\^(-?[0-9a-z])/g, (m, t) => aSup(t));
    x = x.replace(/_(-?[0-9a-z])/g, (m, t) => aSub(t));
  }

  // --- limpieza final: delimitadores, comandos sobrantes y llaves
  x = x.replace(/\$\$/g, "").replace(/\$/g, "");
  x = x.replace(/\\([A-Za-z]+)/g, "$1");
  x = x.replace(/\\/g, "");
  x = x.replace(/[{}]/g, "");
  return x;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------
// mdx: usalo igual que md. Traduce las formulas y, si MathJax esta
// disponible, tambien intenta componer lo que quede.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------
mdx = (strings, ...valores) => {
  const bruto = strings.reduce(
    (acc, trozo, i) => acc + trozo + (i < valores.length ? String(valores[i]) : ""), "");
  return md([tex2uni(bruto)]);
}
```
